answer: A payout is split and hence 27% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The thread schedule is applied in harbor and ripple reveals each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1849 identities would post 1594 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
